original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克加扎省需1800万梅蒂卡尔应对干旱
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 莫桑比克国家灾害管理研究所（INGD）表示，南部加扎省因厄尔尼诺现象引发干旱，需超过1800万梅蒂卡尔（约合28万美元）用于应对，预计将影响42.2万户家庭。当局已在加扎省预置约40吨物资，并设有282个风险管理委员会。干旱已导致当地出现39至40摄氏度高温，花生、玉米等作物开始枯萎。

key_facts.fact: 莫桑比克加扎省因厄尔尼诺干旱需超过1800万梅蒂卡尔应对
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Mozambique’s relief agency, the National Disaster Management Institute (INGD), needs over 18 million meticais (just over US$280,000 at the current exchange rate) to respond to the drought caused by the El Niño phenomenon in the southern province of Gaza

key_facts.fact: 干旱预计影响42.2万户家庭
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: which is expected to affect 422,000 households

key_facts.fact: 当局已在加扎省储存约40吨各类物资
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Authorities have approximately 40 tonnes of various goods in storage, with additional supplies expected to arrive.

key_facts.fact: 加扎省已出现39至40摄氏度高温，花生、玉米等作物开始枯萎
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: intense heatwaves have pushed temperatures to between 39 and 40 degrees Celsius. This is impacting agriculture, with reports of peanut, maize, and other crops beginning to wither.

uncertainties: 干旱对家庭的实际影响规模为预计值，尚未最终确认
目前仅单一来源（Club of Mozambique/AIM）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
